description: Develops asymmetric synthesis through competing diastereomeric transition states, quantifying enantiomeric excess and distinguishing it from major-isomer fraction. Compares enamine and iminium organocatalysis, asymmetric hydrogenation and substrate control, and examines chiral analysis and absolute configuration.
